title: APCC-2020-1011-ZAA-ZAD-DRB-SPP-SPE-SPPA
text:
APCC-2020-1011-ZAA-ZAD-DRB-SPP-SPE-SPPA  Council District: 4 – Raman
  CEQA: ENV-2020-1012-CE  Last Day to Act: 09-26-26
  Plan Area: Hollywood

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  6155 West Rodgerton Drive

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Construction of a five-story single-family dwelling consisting of four levels of residential use atop a partially
  subterranean basement. The structure will have a total floor area of 2,864 square-feet, a Residential Floor
  Area of 2,327 square-feet on a 9,625 square-foot lot (post dedication). The dwelling has an overall height
  of 54 feet. Four parking spaces will be provided. There are no protected trees or significant trees. Five
  retaining walls proposed, varying in height from 10 feet to 11 feet and eight inches, located within the front
  and side yard setbacks. Rodgerton Drive will be improved to a roadway width of 20 feet adjacent to the
  frontage of the site. The Project will require 2,978 cubic yards (CUYD) of cut, 3 CUYD of fill, and export
  2,975 CUYD of soil.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, Section 15303, Class 3, an
  Exemption from CEQA, and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a
  categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies;
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 11.5.7 F of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Specific Plan
  Exception to permit a structure with an overall height of 54 feet, in lieu of the 36 feet otherwise permitted
  per Section 7.G.1 of the Hollywoodland Specific Plan;
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 11.5.7 F., a Specific Plan Exception to permit the location of
  retaining walls within the right of way and within three feet of the front lot line as otherwise prohibited
  per Section 7.B.1 of the Hollywoodland Specific Plan;
  4. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 11.5.7 E, a Specific Plan Project Permit Adjustment to permit a
  front yard setback of eight feet, in lieu of the 10 feet otherwise required for a Project which fronts on a
  Substandard Hillside Limited Street per Section 7.F.1 of the Hollywoodland Specific Plan;
  5. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.28, a Zoning Administrator's Adjustment to permit five retaining
  walls with a maximum height of 11 feet and eight inches within the required front and side yards, in lieu
  of the three and one-half foot limitation in the front yard and the six foot limitation in the side yards per
  LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.22 C.20.(f).;
  6. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.26, a Zoning Administrator's Determination to permit five
  retaining walls with heights ranging 10 feet to 11 feet and eight inches, in lieu of the maximum of one
  retaining wall with a maximum height of 12 feet per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21 C.8.(a);
  7. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.28, a Zoning Administrator’s Determination to permit
  construction of a new single-family dwelling fronting on a Substandard Hillside Limited Street without
  providing an adjacent minimum roadway of at least 20 feet as otherwise required by LAMC Chapter 1
  Section 12.21C.10(i)(2);
  8. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.28, a Zoning Administrator's Determination to permit
  construction of a new single-family dwelling fronting on a Substandard Hillside Limited Street without
  providing a 20-foot-wide continuous paved roadway from the driveway apron to the boundary of the
  Hillside Area as otherwise required permitted by LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21 C.10.(i)(3); and
  9. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Sections 11.5.7 C and 16.50, and Section 9 of the Hollywoodland Specific
  Plan (Ordinance No. 168,121), a Project Permit Compliance Review and Design Review for the
  construction of a new single-family dwelling in the RE9-1-HCR Zone.

  Applicant:  Michele Ghersi
  Representative: William Beauter, MAKE Architecture

  Staff:  Valentina Knox-Jones, City Planner
  valentina.knox.jones@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1741
summary: Proposed construction of a five-story single-family dwelling on a hillside lot in Hollywood with multiple setback, height, and retaining wall adjustments.

locations.text: 6155 West Rodgerton Drive, Los Angeles, CA

details.action: requested approval for new single-family dwelling with specific plan exceptions and zoning adjustments
